newsitem.title: JAPAN: Quick extra budget to help support economy--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Quick extra budget to help support economy--MOF.

text.p: Quick implementation of an extra budget for the current fiscal year would help support the economy until the full state budget for the year starting on April 1 can be implemented, Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told a news conference on Thursday.

Although economic activity is firm at present, as seen in the government's monthly economic report issued on Tuesday, the economy would get the support it needs from implementing the supplementary budget, he said.
This was because the recovery is expected to slow temporarily after the consumption tax is raised to five percent from three percent on April 1, he said.
"Such a supplementary budget will have an important role in the continuation of fiscal measures without pause until the full state budget is implemented," he said.
Both budgets are to be considered by a parliament session starting on January 20.
